title: Ollama
description: The agent works with a model on your Ollama server instead of the cloud: only the server's address is opened, nothing else.

de.title: Ollama
de.description: Der Agent arbeitet mit einem Modell auf Ihrem Ollama-Server statt in der Cloud: nur die Adresse des Servers ist offen, sonst nichts.

llm.label: Ollama server (sandbox-ai llm list), NAME or NAME:MODEL
llm.hint: sandbox-ai llm add ollama --kind ollama --url http://127.0.0.1:11434 --model MODEL

notes: Register it once: sandbox-ai llm add ollama --kind ollama --url http://127.0.0.1:11434 (another address, --api-key-secret SECRET for a key, --vpn PROFILE for a server behind a VPN).

Start it with: ollama serve (OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434; OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 to serve your LAN). Agents need a model with tool calls (qwen3-coder, gpt-oss, ...) and a long context: OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=32768 or more.
OpenCode works with any Ollama; Codex needs Ollama 0.13.3 or later (Responses API), Claude Code 0.14.0 or later (Anthropic Messages API).

NAME:MODEL picks a model (sandbox-ai llm models NAME lists them); without it the server's default (llm add --model) or its only one. sandbox-ai llm check NAME --agent AGENT asks the server whether it has the API that agent needs.

On this host's loopback (http://127.0.0.1:PORT) only with Podman: sandbox-ai opens that one port for the sandbox, and the server must listen on 127.0.0.1. In your LAN or tailnet: a private address, or https.
The agent reaches nothing but the server (--no-provider-defaults): no cloud provider, its login is not copied in; the server's key stays with the connection proxy.
